ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Enzyme-added laundry detergent refers to laundry detergent containing enzyme preparations. A student compared the stain-removing effects of several laundry detergents through an experiment (the more “+”, the better the stain-removing effect), and the experimental results are shown in the table below. Answer the question: What enzyme is added to enzyme-added laundry detergent B?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a table comparing the stain-removing effects of different laundry detergents, with the column headings in order being enzyme-added laundry detergent A, enzyme-added laundry detergent B, enzyme-added laundry detergent C, and enzyme-free laundry detergent (control); the row headings include blood stain and oil stain. The more “+”, the better the stain-removing effect. In the table, enzyme-added laundry detergent B has an effect of “+” on blood stains, similar to the “+” of the enzyme-free laundry detergent control; enzyme-added laundry detergent B has an effect of “+++” on oil stains, clearly stronger than the “+” of the enzyme-free laundry detergent control. Then reason: Enzymes have specificity and can significantly enhance the removal effect for a certain type of stain. B mainly enhances the removal of oil stains, and the main components of oil stains belong to fatty substances; the enzyme that can decompose fat is lipase. Therefore, the enzyme added to enzyme-added laundry detergent B is lipase.
